title.original: OpenApps: Simulating Environment Variations to Measure UI-Agent Reliability
title.zh: OpenApps：模拟环境变化来衡量UI-智能体的可靠性
title.en: OpenApps: Simulating Environment Variations to Measure UI-Agent Reliability

inclusion_reason.zh: OpenApps 的参数化应用模板和批量版本部署器可复用地测量 UI Agent 在环境分布而非单一界面上的可靠性。
inclusion_reason.en: OpenApps' parameterized app templates and bulk version deployment enable reusable reliability measurement over an environment distribution rather than one UI.

abstract.zh: OpenApps 提供可配置外观和内容的轻量应用生态，可低成本生成大量 UI 变体，从而把 Agent 可靠性测量从固定界面扩展到环境分布。
abstract.en: OpenApps provides lightweight applications with configurable appearance and content, cheaply generating UI variants so reliability is measured across an environment distribution rather than one fixed app.

problem.zh: 固定克隆应用只能回答 Agent 在某个版本是否成功，无法估计布局、文案和内容变化引起的跨版本可靠性波动。
problem.en: A fixed app clone only shows whether an agent succeeds on one version and cannot estimate reliability shifts caused by layout, wording, or content changes.

approach.zh: 作者构建六个单 CPU 可运行的开放应用，参数化视觉和数据配置，并在大量独立版本上重复同一任务评测。
approach.en: Six open applications run on one CPU, expose visual and content parameters, and repeat identical tasks over many independently generated versions.

system_design.zh: 生态包含应用模板、配置/数据生成器、版本部署器、任务重放与终态验证器，并按 Agent—任务—版本聚合可靠性。
system_design.en: The ecosystem combines app templates, configuration/data generation, version deployment, task replay, end-state verification, and agent-task-version aggregation.

key_results.zh: 固定应用内表现看似稳定，但跨 UI 变体的成功率可剧烈波动，循环和幻觉动作也随环境配置显著改变。
key_results.en: Performance can look stable within one app yet vary dramatically across UI versions, with looping and hallucinated actions also changing by configuration.

limitations.zh: 六个轻量仿真应用不能覆盖商业应用的动态更新、广告、权限和无障碍栈；变体生成分布也决定可靠性估计。
limitations.en: Six lightweight simulated apps do not cover commercial updates, ads, permissions, or accessibility stacks, and the variant generator defines the estimated reliability distribution.

workloads: OpenApps messenger, calendar, maps, and configurable UI tasks
